title: Lechon Kare-Kare with Filipino Flair
description: A classic Filipino dish with a twist, featuring slow-roasted pork belly served with a rich peanut-based sauce and steamed vegetables.
instructions: Season the pork belly with salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork belly until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork to the preheated oven and roast for 2 hours, or until tender and caramelized.
While the pork is roasting, prepare the peanut sauce by blending peanut butter, vinegar, and water.
Steam the bok choy until tender.
To assemble the dish, slice the roasted pork into thick slabs and serve with a side of steamed bok choy and a drizzle of peanut sauce.
Wrap the pork in puff pastry and serve as a main course.
